# Draft:List of recruitment agencies in the United Kingdom

}}
Introduction
Recruitment agencies and employment websites in the United Kingdom provide a range of services—from general staffing to specialised recruitment in niche sectors. This list includes major multinational agencies, specialist firms focusing on particular professions, and popular online job boards that help employers find suitable candidates.
*Additional specialist agencies in sectors such as healthcare, finance, or legal services can be added as more reliable, independent sources become available.*
General Recruitment Agencies
These agencies provide recruitment services across a wide variety of sectors, from administration and customer service to industrial roles.
* [https://www.adecco.co.uk Adecco UK] – One of the largest staffing agencies, Adecco offers recruitment in a variety of sectors, including office, industrial, and technology.
* [https://www.hays.co.uk Hays Recruitment] – A global recruitment company providing services in sectors including construction, finance, IT, and engineering.
* [https://www.randstad.co.uk Randstad UK] – Offers recruitment services in various industries, from office administration to healthcare and construction.
* [https://www.manpower.co.uk Manpower UK] – A well-established recruitment agency, specialising in temporary and permanent staffing across a range of industries.
* [https://www.reed.co.uk Reed] – A major player in recruitment across a broad spectrum of industries, including education, healthcare, and IT.
Specialist Recruitment Agencies
These agencies focus on niche sectors, providing expertise in hiring professionals in specific industries.
* [https://www.perfecthouseholdstaff.co.uk Perfect Household Staff] – Specialises in placing private household staff, such as nannies, housekeepers, chefs, and chauffeurs.
* [https://www.michaelpage.co.uk Michael Page] – A recruitment agency with a focus on accounting, finance, and professional services, including legal and marketing.
* [https://www.roberthalf.co.uk Robert Half] – Specialises in finance, accounting, IT, and legal recruitment.
* [https://www.morganhunt.com Morgan Hunt] – Focuses on recruitment for the public and not-for-profit sectors, including healthcare, education, and social work.
* [https://www.spencer-ogden.com Spencer Ogden] – Specialises in engineering, energy, and infrastructure sectors, providing recruitment for technical and skilled professionals.
* [https://www.medic-international.com Medic International] – A recruitment agency for healthcare professionals, specialising in the placement of doctors, nurses, and allied health professionals in the UK and abroad.
* [https://www.pro-recruitment.co.uk Pro-Recruitment Group] – Specialises in recruitment for the accounting, legal, and taxation sectors.
Employment Websites
These websites offer job listings and allow candidates to apply directly for roles in a variety of industries.
* [https://www.indeed.co.uk Indeed] – One of the largest job boards globally, offering job listings for a wide range of professions.
* [https://www.cv-library.co.uk CV-Library] – A major UK-based job board with millions of CVs and job listings across various industries.
* [https://www.monster.co.uk Monster UK] – A global online recruitment website with job listings in various sectors, including healthcare, finance, and IT.
* [https://www.gumtree.com Gumtree] – Known for classifieds and job listings, including part-time, full-time, and temporary roles.
